401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

clientId.description: The ID of the client this invoice is assigned to. Leave empty if assigning to a company.

companyId.description: The ID of the company this invoice is assigned. This is required when an invoice is assigned to a company.

templateId.description: Unique ID of the invoice template to use. If provided, template values will be used for line items and invoice metadata.

lineItems[].description: Array of line items. Required if templateId is not provided.

lineItems[].amount.description: Amount in cents. Required if priceId not provided.

lineItems[].priceId.description: Unique ID of the price object. Required if amount is not provided.

lineItems[].description.description: Description of the item, ignored if priceId is provided.

daysUntilDue.description: The number of days from when the invoice is created until it is due. Max value is 30.

taxPercentage.description: Tax percentage to apply to the invoice amount.

paymentMethodPreferences[].description: Array of preferences which specify which payment methods are allowed and how transaction fees are handled for each payment method.

paymentMethodPreferences[].type.description: Payment method type. Values are creditCard or bankAccount.

paymentMethodPreferences[].feePaidByClie.description: When true, the transaction fee is paid by the client, otherwise it is covered by your account.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

clientId.description: The ID of the client this subscription is assigned to. Leave empty if assigning to a company.

companyId.description: The ID of the company this subscription is assigned to. This is required when assigning to a company.

templateId.description: Unique ID of the invoice template to use. If provided, template values will be used for line items and invoice metadata.

lineItems[].description: Array of line items. Required if templateId is not provided.

lineItems[].amount.description: Amount in cents. Required if priceId is not provided.

lineItems[].priceId.description: Unique ID of the price object. Required if amount is not provided.

lineItems[].description.description: Description of the item, ignored if priceId is provided.

memo.description: Arbitrary string attached to the invoice, often used for display.

daysUntilDue.description: The number of days from when the subscription invoice is created until it is due. Max value is 30.

taxPercentage.description: Tax percentage to apply to the invoice amount.

interval.description: Billing frequency. Required if line items do not include a recurring price. Values: day, week, month, quarterly, yearly.

intervalCount.description: Number of intervals between billings. Default value is 1.

paymentMethodPreferences[].description: Array of preferences which specify which payment methods are allowed and how transaction fees are handled for each payment method.

paymentMethodPreferences[].type.description: Payment method type. Values are creditCard or bankAccount.

paymentMethodPreferences[].feePaidByClie.description: When true, the transaction fee is paid by the client, otherwise it is covered by your account.

collectionMethod.description: Specify how to charge for an invoice. Values: sendInvoice or chargeAutomatically.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parentTaskId.description: The parent task of the task, if the task should be a subtask.

status.description: The status of the task, one of todo, inProgress, completed.

internalUserId.description: The UUID of the internal user assigned to this task.

clientId.description: The UUID of the client user assigned to this task. Company ID is required if this field is used.

companyId.description: The UUID of the company assigned to this task. If assigning to a client user, this field is required.

dueDate.description: The date the task is due, in RFC3339 format.

templateId.description: ID of the template to use when creating this task.

viewers[].description: The company or client to grant viewing access to the task.

viewers[].clientId.description: If the task viewer is a client, add both the clientId and their companyId.

viewers[].companyId.description: If the task viewer is a company, only add the companyId and leave clientId empty.
